_comment: Benign teaching sentences for to_bijection_learning (bijection.py). The technique draws a few of these, encodes each with the unit's random cipher, and shows the plaintext/ciphertext pairs so the model learns the mapping in context. Plain, harmless sentences only; a Sonnet pass may extend the list. At least twenty are required.
